lore: Below the Byte Spring the cache shelf is a strip of tide-worn blocks. The island caches lie scattered across it, and every break costs a seek when an island streams in. Each tide eats one more free block. Pack the caches before the shelf crumbles.

lines.start: The shelf's in pieces again. Every gap is a seek when the islands stream in.
lines.move: Block shifted. Keep the caches in one run.
lines.erode: The tide took another free block. It will not give it back.
lines.close: Nearly there. One or two more packs.
lines.win: Clean runs, end to end. The islands will stream like water.
lines.fail: The tides ran out. The caches stream in stutters this season.
